source.author: verg
source.text: Prima hominis facies et pulchro pectore virgo pube tenus, postrema immani corpore pristis, delphinum caudas utero commissa luporum.
source.text_original: Prima hominis facies et pulchro pectore virgo / pube tenus, postrema immani corpore pristis, / delphinum caudas utero commissa luporum.
source.text_english: The first form is that of a human being and, with a beautiful breast, a maiden down to the waist; the last is a monstrous body, a sea-monster, with dolphins’ tails joined to the belly of wolves.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: ubi uenenatissima uipera, prima hominis facies utero commissa luporum?
reuse.text_original: ubi uenenatissima uipera, prima hominis facies utero commissa luporum?
reuse.text_english: Where is the most venomous viper, the first human face entrusted to the wombs of wolves?
